recentItems.description:
#rodddamsrinivas #roddamsreenivas#ThammareddyBharadwaja, #DiviseemaCyclone, #CycloneDevastation, #TollywoodCharity, #NaturalDisasters, #AndhraPradeshCyclones, #iDreamInterviews,
From Diviseema to Vizag: The Untold Realities of Cyclones | Tammareddy Bharadwaja | iDream 

Discussion on Natural Disasters: Famous film director, producer, and social analyst Thammareddy Bharadwaja shares deep insights into how cyclones and heavy storms severely impact coastal people, fishermen, and farmers.

The Impact on the Poor: Explores how natural calamities destroy livelihoods, damage boats, wash away crops, and leave poor and middle-class families struggling to recover.

Memories of the Diviseema Cyclone: Recalls the horrific devastation of the historic Diviseema cyclone, where sand deposits rendered agricultural lands completely barren for years.

Cyclone Preparedness & Government Action: Discusses how modern government precautions, early warnings, and evacuation shelters have drastically reduced human casualties compared to the past.

Tollywood’s Humanitarian Response: Highlights how the Telugu film industry historically and currently steps forward with donations, housing projects, and relief materials during major disasters.

Permanent Solutions vs. Relief: Examines why India focuses heavily on disaster relief and rehabilitation compared to countries like Japan, and the role of political coordination during crises.

recentItems.description:
#GRMaharshi, #SeshachalamEncounter, #DhanushOM, #RedSandalwoodSmuggling, #TirupatiNews, #TrueCrimeTelugu, #AndhraHistory, #iDreamInterviews,
GR Maharshi About Seshachalam forest 20 red sandalwood workers Encounter 2015 | Danush OM Movie 


In-Depth Discussion: Senior journalist GR Maharshi breaks down the real-life incidents and history behind the infamous 2015 Seshachalam red sandalwood encounter.

The 2015 Incident: Details the controversial day when 20 Tamil Nadu woodcutters were shot dead by police in a single day, exploring both police and human rights perspectives.

The Roots of Smuggling: Traces how Veerappan's quarry restrictions in 1993 inadvertently shifted cheap labor toward sandalwood and later red sandalwood smuggling.

The Worker Dynamics: Explains why poor laborers from regions like Salem and Dharmapuri were recruited as cutters and how the courier-to-smuggler network operated.

Political & Syndicates Influence: Highlights how local dons, politicians, and port-level networks in Chennai kept the multi-crore red sandalwood trade alive for decades.

Dhanush’s 'OM' Movie Connection: Analyzes how the upcoming film starring Dhanush connects to this real-life tragedy from the perspective of the laborers rather than just the dons.

recentItems.title: The Single Decision Changed India's Economic History | Suresh Kochattil | PV Narasimha Rao | iDream
recentItems.description:
#SureshKochattil, #IndianEconomy, #1991Reforms, #PVNarasimhaRao, #Privatization, #LPGReforms, #EconomicHistory, #TurningPoints, #iDreamInterviews,
The Single Decision Changed India's Economic History | Suresh Kochattil | PV Narasimha Rao | iDream 

Introduction to Economic Turning Points: Senior journalist Suresh Kochattil breaks down the monumental shifts in India's economy, focusing on the 1991 Liberalization, Privatization, and Globalization (LPG) reforms.

Life Before LPG (The Nostalgia Check): Contrasts modern-day convenience with the struggles of the past, including waiting years for a Bajaj scooter, queuing up for milk packets, and waiting months for a telephone or gas connection.

The 1991 Financial Crisis & Gold Mortgage: Discusses how India was down to just weeks of foreign exchange reserves, leading to the dramatic move of pledging India's gold reserves in London under the Chandrashekhar government.

PV Narasimha Rao & Dr. Manmohan Singh's Bold Move: Highlights how Prime Minister PV Narasimha Rao and Finance Minister Manmohan Singh opened up the economy, ending the rigid "license raj" and steering India toward unstoppable growth.

The Debate on Privatization & Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs): Analyzes why government-run businesses struggled (like Air India, BSNL, and Ordnance factories) and why privatization, disinvestment, and inviting foreign direct investment (FDI) became essential for efficiency.

The Modern Era of Open Competition: Explores how open markets transformed everyday life, from multiple vehicle and flight options to instant digital communication and global brands readily available in India.

recentItems.title: Tammareddy Bharadwaja About 248-page counter affidavit lie!? | Neha Bora | CJP Protest | iDream
recentItems.description:
#rodddamsrinivas #roddamsreenivas #TammareddyBharadwaja, #ElectionCommission, #IDreamNews,  #VoterDeletion, #SupremeCourt, 
Tammareddy Bharadwaja About 248-page counter affidavit lie!? | Neha Bora | CJP Protest | iDream 

Introduction: In this thought-provoking interview with iDream, prominent filmmaker and social analyst Tammareddy Bharadwaja shares his unfiltered views on the Election Commission's 248-page counter affidavit submitted to the Supreme Court regarding voter deletions.

The ECI Affidavit Controversy: Bharadwaja questions the credibility of the election commission's data, pointing out major contradictions between RTI replies, press statements, and court affidavits, calling them misleading.

Voter Deletion & Missing Millions: Discussing the mass deletion of votes, he raises logical questions about where millions of voters supposedly shifted or vanished, challenging the rationale behind locked-door assumptions.

Student Protests & Foreign Funding Debate: Addressing criticisms about youth and student-led movements (like Neha Bora's protests), he defends the youth's right to question the system, arguing that focusing on funding instead of the core problem is a diversion tactic.

Decline of Democratic Institutions: The discussion wraps up with a critical look at how constitutional institutions, political parties, and governance are functioning, emphasizing that the fight is about saving democracy rather than favoring any single party.
